title: Persistent Eyes of Aggressor Network Blinded
text:
Persistent Eyes of Aggressor Network Blinded"

"Each time an advanced drone is destroyed in Iran's skies, the outcome is not merely the loss of a multi-million-dollar asset; a vital link in the enemy's reconnaissance and targeting chain is also rendered inoperable."

"**A paradigm shift in air defense:** Defensive strategies are no longer tailored exclusively to counter manned aircraft. Engaging smaller, cheaper, long-endurance drones equipped with electronic intelligence (ELINT) systems has become a primary domain of modern warfare."

"*Excerpt from the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) television special program, "Operation Eagle Eye Hunt."*
